statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-2006 (PostgreSQL missing validation of multibyte character length executes arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 18.2: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-2006/ lists 18.2 as the fixed release for major version 18, and the 18.2 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.2/, include it. Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD lists CVE-2026-2006 under its 18.2-r0 secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD. The DHI postgresql18 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built with Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD from the upstream PostgreSQL source release of the same version, and the postgres server binary in each published build (18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0), on both x86_64 and aarch64, reports that PostgreSQL release. The affected code is in the PostgreSQL server, /usr/libexec/postgresql18/postgres in the postgresql18 package of every published build for Alpine 3.23. 18.2-r0, built from PostgreSQL 18.2, is the first published build for Alpine 3.23 carrying the fix. The earlier published build for Alpine 3.23 (18.1-r0) is built from an earlier PostgreSQL 18 release and is recorded as affected.
